title: Documentation and Hooks
summary: This module manages the generation of API documentation and integrates various hooks to fetch and display live statistics on the website.

nodes.label: Initialize Hero Interactive
nodes.title: Initialize Hero Interactive
nodes.description: Initializes interactive elements on the hero section of the documentation website, handling user interactions with buttons and tabs.

nodes.label: Fetch Stats on Config
nodes.title: Fetch Stats on Config
nodes.description: A MkDocs hook that fetches and injects live statistics (e.g., GitHub stars, PyPI downloads) into the site configuration during build time.

nodes.label: Fetch GitHub Contributors
nodes.title: Fetch GitHub Contributors
nodes.description: Retrieves the total number of contributors for the GitHub repository.

nodes.label: Fetch Latest Release Info
nodes.title: Fetch Latest Release Information
nodes.description: Fetches details about the latest stable release from GitHub, including version and publication date.

nodes.label: Fetch PyPI Downloads
nodes.title: Fetch PyPI Downloads
nodes.description: Retrieves the monthly download count for the package from PyPI.

nodes.label: Fetch GitHub Stars
nodes.title: Fetch GitHub Stars
nodes.description: Obtains the number of stargazers for the GitHub repository.

nodes.label: Fetch Discord Members
nodes.title: Fetch Discord Members
nodes.description: Retrieves the approximate member count for the Discord server.

nodes.label: Fetch Merged PRs
nodes.title: Fetch Merged Pull Requests
nodes.description: Counts the number of merged pull requests in the last year on GitHub.

nodes.label: Generate Markdown Docs
nodes.title: Generate Markdown Documentation
nodes.description: Generates Markdown documentation files for public classes and functions within the DSPy package, organizing them by category.

nodes.label: Generate Category Index
nodes.title: Generate Category Index
nodes.description: Creates or updates an 'index.md' landing page for each API category directory, listing links to its child documentation pages.

groups.label: Documentation Generation
groups.title: Documentation Generation
groups.description: Handles the automated creation and structuring of API documentation in Markdown format.

groups.label: Website Hooks
groups.title: Website Hooks
groups.description: Integrates custom functionality into the documentation website build process and interactive elements.

groups.label: External Data Fetching
groups.title: External Data Fetching
